notes: Source is the official NovaStar manufacturer specification PDF (V1.7.0, 2024-07-08) hosted at oss.novastar.tech — the authoritative spec sheet. Caveats: (1) HDMI ports are labeled "HDMI 1.3" (HDMI version 1.3) on the device silkscreen; the allowed grade enum only offers hdmi-1.4/2.0/2.1, so hdmi-1.4 was chosen as the closest available id — this is NOT a confirmed HDMI 2.0-class port, it is actually HDMI 1.3. (2) The 3G-SDI and GENLOCK IN-LOOP ports' exact connector type (BNC) is inferred from the rear-panel photo showing round threaded connectors, which is standard for SDI/genlock, though the spec text itself does not spell out "BNC". (3) OPT1/OPT2 are SFP-style hot-swappable optical modules (LC fiber, single-mode OS1/OS2 or multi-mode OM3/OM4, 9.95-11.3 Gbit/s) — graded as eth-10g as the closest bandwidth-scale match since there is no dedicated "10G fiber" grade; actual optical transceiver could also be modeled as connector "sfp" but LC was chosen since the spec explicitly states "Connector type: LC". (4) LIGHT SENSOR is a NovaStar-proprietary connector not well represented by any id in the allowed list; euroblock was used as a rough placeholder — treat with low confidence. (5) There is also a separate "VX600 Pro" variant with its own spec sheet; this entry is for the base VX600 model only. (6) Product also ships as a "flight case" or "carton" package variant — does not affect port list. (7) Rack height 50.1mm corresponds to 1U.

ports.name: 3G-SDI IN & LOOP
ports.note: Supports ST-424 (3G), ST-292 (HD), ST-259 (SD); loop-through output supported; max input 1920x1080@60Hz

ports.name: HDMI 1.3-1
ports.note: Rear panel labels port as HDMI 1.3 (HDMI version 1.3 compliant); HDCP 1.4 compliant; loop-through output supported on this port; closest available grade id is hdmi-1.4 since hdmi-1.3 is not in the allowed scale

ports.name: HDMI 1.3-2
ports.note: Second HDMI 1.3 input; HDCP 1.4 compliant; closest available grade id is hdmi-1.4

ports.name: DVI IN & LOOP
ports.note: Single-link DVI, max input 1920x1200@60Hz, HDCP 1.4 compliant, loop-through output supported

ports.name: OPT 1
ports.note: Self-adaptive 10G optical fiber port: input when paired with a Pixelhue video processor, output when paired with a fiber converter; carries up to 1x 4Kx1K@60Hz or 2x 2Kx1K@60Hz; transmission rate 9.95-11.3 Gbit/s; LC connector, single-mode OS1/OS2 or multi-mode OM3/OM4 module (hot-swappable)

ports.name: OPT 2
ports.note: Output-only fiber port; copies or backs up the signal carried on the 6 Ethernet output ports; same optical module specs as OPT1 (9.95-11.3 Gbit/s, LC connector)

ports.name: ETHERNET 1
ports.note: LED sending/Gigabit Ethernet output; supports audio output (must connect to port 1 or 2 for multifunction-card audio parsing); max loading 3.9 million pixels across all 6 ports combined

ports.name: ETHERNET 2
ports.note: LED sending/Gigabit Ethernet output; supports audio output

ports.name: HDMI 1.3 (Output)
ports.note: Rear-panel output HDMI labeled HDMI 1.3, for monitoring or video output; resolution adjustable; closest available grade id is hdmi-1.4

ports.name: ETHERNET (control)
ports.note: Control port; connects to control PC or router for NovaLCT/V-Can control (not a video/LED output port)

ports.name: USB (Type-B)
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-B; connects to control PC and serves as input connector for device cascading

ports.name: USB (Type-A)
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A; output connector for device cascading

ports.name: GENLOCK IN-LOOP
ports.note: Genlock sync input with loop-through; connects to external sync (tri-level/black burst) source; connector inferred as BNC from rear-panel photo of round threaded connector, typical for genlock on this product class

ports.name: LIGHT SENSOR
ports.note: Proprietary light-sensor connector for ambient brightness auto-adjustment; not in the provided connector list as a distinct type — approximated as euroblock (small screw/pin connector); actual connector is a NovaStar-proprietary round sensor jack, closest visual match in the enum is a small pin-style connector

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 100-240V~, 1.5A, 50/60Hz, rated 35W; rear panel shows a standard IEC inlet with rocker power switch (IEC C13/14 style)
